earnings.title: LIBERTY MEDIA CORPORATION REPORTS
highlights: The total remaining repurchase authorization for Liberty Media as of November 1, 2026 is $1.1 billion.

quotes.text: F1 continues to deliver exceptional performance, extending its reach and influence while staying nimble throughout a dynamic year. At MotoGP, we executed on strategic senior management additions and are building the foundation to unlock the sport’s significant long-term growth potential.
quotes.by: Derek Chang, Liberty Media President and CEO

quotes.text: We are nearing the end of another extraordinary season, which has seen Kimi Antonelli, F1’s youngest ever champion, crowned and the sport has never been stronger. Every race this season has sold out, with more than half setting attendance records and our digital impressions and audiences continue to grow.
quotes.by: Stefano Domenicali, Formula 1 President and CEO

items.heading: Our businesses may not realize the benefits of acquisitions or other strategic investments and initiatives.
Weak and uncertain economic conditions may reduce consumer demand for products, services and events offered by our businesses.

Our Company has overlapping directors with QVC Group, Liberty Broadband, GCI Liberty and Liberty Live and overlapping management with Liberty Broadband, GCI Liberty and Liberty Live, which may lead to conflicting interests.
Both of our operating subsidiaries have operations outside of the U.S. that are subject to numerous operational risks.
We may be subject to significant tax liabilities related to the Liberty Sirius XM Holdings Split-Off and the Liberty Live Split-Off.

The degradation, failure or misuse of the Company’s information systems could cause a disruption of services or improper loss, use and disclosure of personal data or other confidential information, resulting in increased costs, liabilities or loss of revenue.
